## Approved plan task B2

- **Functional scope/files:** ChatLive init/load helpers and BridgeClient. Use shared Commands for create/resume/history. Keep title updates, sidebar listing/deletion, feedback, source previews and detailed trace UI on their existing supported paths unless a change is necessary for parity.
- **Tests before implementation:** create once, resume existing, missing-conversation BO fallback, persisted welcome message, empty history, order/roles, source normalization, ratings/feedback restoration, sidebar title updates, database IDs and subsequent message context.
- **Branches:** successful and failed create/load/persist; empty/nonempty history; an archived/deleted/missing conversation must follow the explicitly recorded existing BO behavior. No accidental switch to widget authorization semantics.
- **Mocking:** real conversations/DB and PubSub, external model edge only for a subsequent send.
- **Documentation:** BO init/history sequence and ownership split between UI and bridge/Engine.
- **Action reuse:** reuse Engine create/get/list_messages and existing persistence; keep welcome-content presentation policy explicit. No second history store or use of broad Accounts.History recall for restoration.
- **Done:** no direct BO conversation-init/history orchestration remains outside the shared command path; all adjacent BO features still work.

## Execution requirements
Branch: refactor/webbridge. Source: GitHub www-zaq-ai/zaq#830. Read AGENTS.md, docs/exec-plans/PLAN_STRATEGY.md, docs/agent-tools.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md, and applicable service guides before implementation. Shared contracts, module responsibilities, reuse evidence, decisions and regression obligations are in parent zaq-pkd. Write specified immediate tests first; use real internal boundaries and mock only external edges. Preserve canonical-history authorization, config-scoped delivery and Engine admission/finalization. New/substantially rewritten feature E2E must wait for B3 human approval. Inbound message.edit is excluded; outbound streaming edits remain included.


## Sequencing
Blocked by zaq-pkd.5 (B1).
Blocks zaq-pkd.7 (B3).
Human BO approval: zaq-pkd.7. Persistent consolidated E2E/regression issue: zaq-pkd.8. Widget decision gate: zaq-pkd.9.

comments.text: Migrated BO conversation initialization/resume and history restoration to shared Web Commands through BridgeClient/Channels/WebBridge. ChatLive no longer issues Engine get/get!/create/messages actions directly. WebBridge reuses Engine get/create/list_messages, preserves missing-conversation fallback, and projects ordered history with persisted IDs, sources, ratings, metadata/trace, model, latency and token fields required by the existing UI. ChatLive remains the explicit owner of BO welcome presentation and persists the fixed welcome only when init reports a new conversation; Engine :conversation now supports add_message by conversation_id to avoid leaking Ecto structs through public Responses. Sidebar listing/deletion, title subscriptions, feedback/rating and previews remain unchanged. Action reuse: reused existing Engine conversation operations and persistence through NodeRouter; extended the existing :conversation action backward-compatibly for add_message-by-id rather than creating another operation/store/Action. No agent tool exposure is appropriate. Validation: focused suite 194 tests + 1 property passed; final Engine/ChatLive repeat 174 tests passed; mix q and diff/boundary audit passed. One characterization was renamed/reordered because shared history now performs the get before the later injected lookup failure; behavior assertions were preserved. Existing non-failing :license_manager warning and intermittent MCP Finch test noise remain. Beadwork remote sync remains blocked by SSH credentials.

title: [830] B2 — Migrate BO initialization/history and preserve adjacent capabilities
